blocks.html: Penetrations of a fire-resistance-rated floor, floor/ceiling assembly or the ceiling membrane of a roof/ceiling assembly not required to be enclosed in a shaft by Section 711.1 shall be protected in accordance with Sections 714.4.1 through 714.4.2.2.
